title: BitmapDisplayObject missing blendMode, filters, colorEffect fields
description: BitmapDisplayObject in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts (lines ~667-685) lacks blendMode, filters, and colorEffect fields. Other placed display objects (SymbolInstance, ShapeDisplayObject) have these fields. Bitmaps placed on stage can never receive blend modes or filter effects. Fix: add optional blendMode, filters, and colorEffect fields to BitmapDisplayObject in types.ts. Then update the SWF compiler (compile.ts) to emit PlaceObject3 for bitmap instances when blendMode/filters/colorEffect are set, analogous to how SymbolInstance emits PO3.
